diagnostics: Workbox source inspection showed updatefound observation stops after later/external install; native registration watch fixes failed-install recovery. First install is excluded to avoid a phantom update.
Message helper drops its asynchronous result; direct postMessage makes synchronous delivery failure testable and recoverable.
Reload waits for activated state, not the earlier controllerchange event; edits during held activation are flushed again.

Visual review exposed focused action clipping after short-screen resize. Fixed with a scoped ResizeObserver and scroll padding; interrupted the earlier full run and started a fresh frozen-build suite.
Forced-colour focus checks enter keyboard modality; tests do not force production styles, fake focus rings, relax assertions or extend existing suite timeouts.
limits: Physical touch/software keyboards, OS IME, spoken assistive technology and real-device GPU/battery remain open
